pairs: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus,
to Philemon, our beloved fellow laborer,
and to Apphia, most beloved sister,
and to Archippus, our fellow soldier,
et ecclesiæ, quæ in domo tua est.
and to the church which is in your house.
et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Domino Jesu Christo.
from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
I give thanks to my God,
semper memoriam tui faciens in orationibus meis,
always keeping remembrance of you in my prayers,
(for I am hearing of your charity
which you have in the Lord Jesus
ut communicatio fidei tuæ evidens fiat in agnitione omnis operis boni, quod est in vobis in Christo Jesu.
so that the participation of your faith may become evident by the recognition of every good work which is in you in Christ Jesus.
For I have found great joy
quia viscera sanctorum requieverunt per te,
because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed by you,
Propter quod multam fiduciam habens in Christo Jesu imperandi tibi quod ad rem pertinet:
Because of this, I have enough confidence in Christ Jesus to command you concerning certain things,
since you are so much like Paul:
nunc autem et vinctus Jesu Christi:
an old man and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
I beg you, on behalf of my son,
whom I have begotten in my chains,
In times past, he was useless to you,
nunc autem et mihi et tibi utilis,
but now he is useful both to me and to you.
So I have sent him back to you.
Tu autem illum, ut mea viscera, suscipe:
And may you receive him like my own heart.
I myself wanted to retain him with me,
ut pro te mihi ministraret in vinculis Evangelii:
so that he might minister to me, on your behalf, while I am in the chains of the Gospel.
sine consilio autem tuo nihil volui facere,
But I was willing to do nothing without your counsel,
uti ne velut ex necessitate bonum tuum esset,
so as not to make use of your good deed as if out of necessity,
Forsitan enim ideo discessit ad horam a te,
So perhaps, then, he departed from you for a time,
so that you might receive him again for eternity,
no longer as a servant, but,
in place of a servant, a most beloved brother,
quanto autem magis tibi et in carne, et in Domino?
but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord!
Therefore, if you hold me to be a companion,
receive him as you would me.
But if he has harmed you in any way,
or if he is in your debt,
I, Paul, have written this with my own hand:
And I need not tell you,
that you are also in debt yourself, to me.
May I delight with you in the Lord!
Confidens in obedientia tua scripsi tibi:
that you will do even more than what I say.
Simul autem et para mihi hospitium:
But also, at once, prepare a lodging for me.
nam spero per orationes vestras donari me vobis.
For I am hoping, through your prayers, to present myself to you.
Salutat te Epaphras concaptivus meus in Christo Jesu,
Greet Epaphras, my fellow captive in Christ Jesus,
Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi cum spiritu vestro.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
